space.label: Playbooks
space.answers: How do multiple personas, skills, tools, workflows, artifacts, and quality gates coordinate toward an outcome?
space.write: Add or change a playbook only when the work is a reusable multi-stage operating model, not a one-off task.
do_not: Do not copy persona or skill definitions into a playbook when a reference is enough.

routes.request: Compose a reusable multi-stage operating model
first_reads: Template references when the outcome starts from a reusable artifact
non_triggers: A one-off task with no reusable stages or handoffs
routes.next_handoff: Validate linked records, gates, recovery, and learning loop before handoff.

routes.request: Coordinate a shared problem across multiple Personas
non_triggers: A request that does not need shared state, attribution, or handoffs
routes.next_handoff: Keep contributions attributable and require a concrete solution-quality gate.

first_reads: active Work Order or GitHub issue
non_triggers: A Multi-Persona Collaboration run that synthesizes one solution from named Personas
A single-workstream implementation that does not need parallel dispatch
Runtime execution, merge, or nested agent spawning as if this Playbook were an executor
routes.next_handoff: After Playbook selection, continue from the target repository's current instructions and source. Ground each candidate workstream there and classify it confirmed, qualified, or contradicted before dispatch. Dispatch only confirmed or qualified workstreams. Keep the coordinator thin. Give each implementer one workstream, one branch, and one PR, then STOP. Pass compact GitHub-reference handoffs. Review from current GitHub state, including problem correctness against current owner/source. Apply scoped corrections and re-review; recording corrections is not terminal. Treat merge as a separately authorized mutation. Do not nest implementer agents or copy child transcripts into the coordinator. After Playbook selection, execution is grounded in the target repository. For external target repositories, Persona-Library is not an additional execution dependency. If Persona-Library itself is the target repository, or target-repository local instructions require Persona-Library records, follow those local routing requirements.
